entities.name: Paging procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to page UE when NAS signalling messages or user data is pending to be sent to UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access, subject to paging restrictions.

entities.name: Timer T3513
entities.description: Timer started by AMF when initiating paging procedure. Stopped when integrity-protected response is received or NGAP UE context resume request indication received.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where paging procedure is initiated by network for pending NAS signalling or user data.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: Network-stored restriction that determines when paging should or should not be performed based on restriction type and pending data/signalling type.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to respond to paging when in 5GMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE for mobility and periodic registration update in response to paging.

entities.name: Integrity-protected response
entities.description: Response from UE that is integrity protected and successfully integrity checked by network, required to stop T3513 timer.

entities.name: Allowed CAG list
entities.description: List provided by AMF to lower layer indicating allowed Closed Access Groups, not provided when emergency PDU session is active.

relations.description: Network starts timer T3513 when initiating paging procedure.
Paging procedure is initiated when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Paging procedure execution is guarded by paging restriction conditions.
Timer T3513 is stopped when integrity-protected response is received and successfully checked.
UE initiates service request procedure as a response to paging.
UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message as a response to paging.
AMF may provide allowed CAG list to lower layer during paging procedure.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message requires integrity protection for T3513 stopping conditions.
